goal: Turn the Unity 6 BallRunnerHybrid project into a clean, playable, testable, build-ready vertical slice with safe scene flow, centralized ball count, deterministic gate/obstacle behavior, runtime UI sync, and validation tooling.

phases.title: Project Discovery
phases.objective: Audit the Unity project structure, current implementation state, scene flow, and the highest-risk runtime defects before further implementation.

tasks.title: Unity project audit and architecture review
tasks.prompt: Analyze the provided Unity project snapshot and produce a concrete audit focused on: scene flow, build order, state management, ball count ownership, gate/obstacle event safety, auto-setup idempotency, and hidden compile/runtime risks. Do not assume unshown files. Return only strict JSON.

tasks.title: Gameplay loop, UX, and QA checklist review
tasks.prompt: Review the provided Unity runner snapshot as a first vertical slice. Evaluate gameplay readability, level pacing, gate and obstacle clarity, HUD feedback, restart/menu flow, and mobile/desktop control feel. Produce concrete QA and UX recommendations. Return only strict JSON.

phases.title: Implementation Gap Review
phases.objective: Use the discovery outputs to identify remaining blockers after the current implementation pass and define the next safest implementation work.

tasks.title: Remaining implementation blockers
tasks.prompt: Using the provided snapshot and prior task outputs, identify the highest-priority remaining blockers to reach playable, build-ready quality. Focus on singleton lifetime, stale references, duplicate trigger paths, level wiring, validation depth, and restart/menu reliability. Return only strict JSON.

tasks.title: Smoke test and acceptance review
tasks.prompt: Using the provided snapshot and prior outputs, produce a concise release QA checklist for this Unity runner. Mark the most likely fail points for first play, restart flow, win/fail UX, count correctness, obstacle fairness, and build validation. Return only strict JSON.
